source_observation: Message types differ in PENDING/SENT handling and ACK paths
decision_needed: Which types require destination ACK and what counts as delivered
recommended_baseline: Separate accepted, persisted, and delivered states; accept ACK only from the expected receiver for explicitly eligible message types.

source_observation: Pending selection uses retry_date and expiry-derived intervals; source does not prove an official attempt cap
decision_needed: What is the retry ceiling/backoff and terminal outcome
acceptance_evidence: Approved retry policy and boundary tests
recommended_baseline: Use bounded backoff with an owner-approved attempt cap; make exhaustion/expiry a terminal observable outcome. Product and Operations choose numeric values.

source_observation: MessageManager applies defaults/caps; negative TTL can survive observed branch
decision_needed: Are negative/zero TTL valid and what does expiry mean to clients
acceptance_evidence: Approved API contract and validation tests
recommended_baseline: Reject negative TTL; preserve the existing default when TTL is omitted; explicitly define zero TTL before treating it as immediate, default, or non-expiring.

source_observation: Some sender recovery paths skip DB recreation for binary content; other routing paths may persist
decision_needed: Must offline binary payloads survive restart and for how long
acceptance_evidence: Approved binary delivery contract and restart test
recommended_baseline: Give offline binary messages the same durability as text unless the product contract explicitly marks them best-effort; specify retention and test restart recovery.

source_observation: MessageCRUD can skip async submit after cumulative task threshold
decision_needed: Should overload reject, block, retry, or accept best-effort
acceptance_evidence: Chosen overload behavior and saturation test
recommended_baseline: Do not silently lose writes when durability is promised; overload must produce an explicit rejection or durable deferral with observable metrics. Async TL/Operations choose the admission mechanism.

source_observation: RegistrationManager calls UserAuthentication.authenticate; inspected implementation is TODO/no-op
decision_needed: Which credentials/identity checks are mandatory at each registration route
acceptance_evidence: Approved threat model and negative auth tests
recommended_baseline: Fail closed when identity cannot be authenticated; no-op or unavailable authentication must never authorize registration. Security/Product define credentials and role per route.

source_observation: Some servlet token checks depend on Keylead activation and token prefix handling
decision_needed: Which token formats and fail-closed behavior are required
acceptance_evidence: Approved auth contract and disabled-Keylead test
recommended_baseline: Document one token format and fail closed when Keylead/authentication is disabled or unavailable; define rotation and status behavior with Security.

source_observation: Observed routes map blocks to differing statuses/redirects and threshold branches
decision_needed: Which consumer-visible status/body/retry headers are contractual
acceptance_evidence: Approved endpoint contract and threshold tests
recommended_baseline: Standardize a rate-limit block response (recommended 429 with a stable body and Retry-After where retry is meaningful); version any compatibility change.

source_observation: Source has synthetic timeout/internal mappings and HTTP status handling gaps
decision_needed: What status/duration/error body must callers receive for each failure
acceptance_evidence: Approved mapping table and integration tests
recommended_baseline: Use stable mappings: invalid caller input→400, downstream timeout→504, downstream transport/upstream failure→502; define duration and response schema with API owners.

source_observation: Request/body/query/message preview values may reach logs
decision_needed: Which fields are allowed, masked, retained and searchable
acceptance_evidence: Approved field-level logging policy plus sanitized sample
recommended_baseline: Allowlist operational metadata; mask credentials and exclude raw body/query/message preview by default; retention/search fields require Security/Privacy approval.

source_observation: Behavior depends on settings such as DB insert, rate-limit, internal-send and provider flags
decision_needed: Which flags are enabled per environment and who owns rollout
acceptance_evidence: Versioned effective configuration and startup validation
recommended_baseline: Use typed, environment-specific configuration with a named owner; validate required values at startup and keep security-sensitive features disabled unless explicitly enabled.
